title: ¡Qué hacer!
director: Saul Landau, Raúl Ruiz, Nina Serrano
actors: Sandra Archer, Aníbal Reyna, Richard Stahl
plot: A Brechtian mix of political fiction, real-life footage and Country Joe McDonald music. In Chile in 1970, a young woman Peace Corps worker becomes involved with a mysterious American 'businessman' and a local revolutionary.
